title: The four tarot suits and their elements
description: The four tarot suits explained: wands, cups, swords and pentacles, their elements and themes, and how the suits can shape what you notice in a spread.

scenes.headline: The four tarot suits and their elements
scenes.caption: A tarot deck has four suits, each linked to an element and an area of life. Knowing them helps you read a spread at a glance.
scenes.vo: A tarot deck has four suits, each linked to an element and an area of life. Knowing them helps you read a spread at a glance.

scenes.headline: Wands: fire
scenes.caption: Wands are linked with fire, and with energy, drive and action. Wands cards often speak about enthusiasm, ambition, creativity and the way you spend your effort.
scenes.vo: Wands: fire. Wands are linked with fire, and with energy, drive and action. Wands cards often speak about enthusiasm, ambition, creativity and the way you spend your effort.

scenes.headline: Cups: water
scenes.caption: Cups belong to water, and to feelings and relationships. They cover love, friendship, family, intuition, nostalgia and emotional life in general.
scenes.vo: Cups: water. Cups belong to water, and to feelings and relationships. They cover love, friendship, family, intuition, nostalgia and emotional life in general.
